profile.headline: Software Engineer at Waymo
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in Android development, skilled in conceptualizing and implementing systems to streamline processes and enhance user experiences. Passionate about pushing technological boundaries and delivering high-quality solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working on integrating new IoT features into iRobot Home application for Android platform. My daily duty is working closely with product manager, data scientist and UX to investigate and design what should be implemented in the app and how it should be implemented.

- Working with cross-platform teams such as products, designs, data and cloud to integrate more data-driven features to app to gather more data to help us understand more about the interactive between users, robots and our app. 

iRobot Home App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.irobot.home

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Work with Endor team to make enhancements for external tools for product demo.
- Investigating new build tool for PatientSecure product such as Cake .. to work/replace with current TeamCity build tool.
- Working on defects to make sure there will not be regression.
- Testing regression for Bahia release builds

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
▪ Design, code, and test new PatientSecure product features.
▪ Work within a Scrum team to plan, scope, build, and deliver software.
▪ Work with new enhancements for Cosmos and PatientSecure Admin products.
▪ Ensure that system scales to support the larger healthcare databases.
